# HomeSight

> > HomeSight is a Seattle-based nonprofit organization providing affordable homeownership programs, homebuyer education, real estate development, and community development services in Southeast Seattle and throughout Washington.

HomeSight develops affordable housing projects like Othello Square and U-lex cooperative housing near Othello light rail station, while offering homebuyer education classes, down payment assistance, workforce development through Ready to Work, and supporting initiatives like the Black Home Initiative's Field Order 15 Fund for Black developers.

## Key Topics

- Affordable homeownership
- Homebuyer education
- Community development
- U-lex cooperative housing
- Othello Square development
- Southeast Seattle
- Down payment assistance
- Black Home Initiative
- Field Order 15 Fund
- Ready to Work program
- Co-op housing
- Small business support
- Essential Southeast Seattle
- Workforce development
- Immigrant and refugee services

## Homebuyer Education & Workshops

- [ZOOM Homebuyer Education Class](https://homesightwa.org/events/zoom-homebuyer-education-class): Online homebuyer education class for first-time buyers via Zoom
- [Home Buyer Education Course](https://homesightwa.org/events/home-buyer-education-course-5): Three-part homebuyer education course via Zoom training
- [U-lex Prospective Buyers' Workshops on Zoom](https://homesightwa.org/events/u-lex-prospective-buyers-workshops-on-zoom-4): U-lex co-op housing workshops for prospective buyers in Seattle
- [U-lex Prospective Buyers' Workshops on Zoom](https://homesightwa.org/events/u-lex-prospective-buyers-workshops-on-zoom-3): Zoom workshops for U-lex co-op housing prospective buyers in Seattle
- [Discover Affordable Homeownership at U-lex: April Zoom Workshops](https://homesightwa.org/zoom-meetings/discover-affordable-homeownership-at-u-lex-april-zoom-workshops): April Zoom workshops for U-lex cooperative homeownership near Othello station
- [Discover Affordable Homeownership at U-lex: February Onsite Workshops at Othello UW Commons](https://homesightwa.org/upcoming-event/discover-affordable-homeownership-at-u-lex-february-onsite-workshops-at-othello-uw-commons-2): February onsite workshops at Othello UW Commons for U-lex homeownership

## Community Development Programs

- [Ready to Work](https://homesightwa.org/community-development/ready-to-work): Ready to Work ESL & workforce development program for immigrants/refugees
- [Essential Southeast Seattle](https://homesightwa.org/essential-southeast-seattle): ESES Collective business directory & community resources for SE Seattle
